applications.title: TaskFlow Pro
applications.description: An interactive Kanban-style project management app with visual workflows, timeline views, and subtask tracking.
applications.longDescription: TaskFlow Pro is a comprehensive project management solution designed for remote teams. It combines the visual ease of Kanban boards with power features like interactive Gantt charts, deep work timers, automatic standup summaries, and real-time collaboration. Track your projects from conception to release with full analytics and task state transitions.
features: Drag-and-drop Kanban boards with custom swimlanes
Interactive Gantt charts & milestone tracking
Built-in Pomodoro focus timer with telemetry
Team workload balancing and capacity views
Detailed performance analytics and completion velocity
Custom fields, tags, and priority weights
Subtask nesting and checklist dependency trees
Automatic markdown release notes generation

applications.title: Nova Editor
applications.description: A lightweight web-based Markdown editor featuring real-time preview, folder management, and local backup capabilities.
applications.longDescription: Nova Editor is a beautiful, minimalist markdown editor designed for writers and developers. It features side-by-side synchronized rendering, full LaTeX math support, mermaid.js diagram visualization, and offline-first storage. Create nested directory structures directly in your browser and sync with major cloud providers or local files effortlessly.
features: Synchronized markdown editor and HTML side-by-side preview
Mermaid.js diagramming and flowcharts inside markdown
LaTeX mathematical formula formatting with KaTeX
Nested folder tree structure with file system drag-and-drop
Local-first browser auto-save and history rollbacks
Dark, sepia, and writing-focused focus mode themes
Word, character, and reading-time counters
Direct export to PDF, HTML, and Markdown formats

applications.title: FitSphere Tracker
applications.description: A comprehensive fitness tracking dashboard with workout plan builders, diet tracking, and interactive progress analytics.
applications.longDescription: FitSphere is a health companion that simplifies exercise and diet logging. Design custom multi-week routines, search a library of 800+ animated exercises, track macronutrient breakdown, and visualize body measurement trends over time. Features elegant, interactive charts representing energy burned, active minutes, and volume load.
features: Interactive exercise routine planner with drag-reordering
Macronutrient calorie and water intake calculators
Volume weight-lifting and cardio logging systems
Interactive dynamic charts for progress visualization
Animated exercise instruction guides
Daily habit streaks and consistency heatmaps
Sleep quality index correlation and analytics
Custom PDF workouts export for paper tracking

applications.title: Apex Finance Wallet
applications.description: An all-in-one crypto and fiat personal finance tracking dashboard with currency conversions, budget trackers, and stock tracking.
applications.longDescription: Apex Finance offers a single source of truth for your net worth. It bridges cryptocurrency wallets, bank ledger files, and brokerage stock lists to render clean visual aggregates of asset distribution, monthly spending forecasts, and debt reduction progress. Fully responsive, highly secure, and optimized for rapid offline use.
features: Cryptocurrency and stock portfolio price tickers
Multi-currency conversion tables with historical tables
Envelope budgeting system with overspend warnings
Interactive asset allocation pie charts and trendlines
Recurring invoice, bill, and dividend payment schedulers
CVS and bank statement transactional parsers
Tax estimation reports and bracket helpers
Secure local-first private encrypted backups

applications.title: EcoMap Green Hubs
applications.description: A community-focused interactive map for identifying and reviewing local ecological hubs, recycling points, and clean energy sites.
applications.longDescription: EcoMap leverages crowdsourced reporting to map recycling hubs, composting depots, repair cafés, and electric vehicle charging locations. Users can filter locations by specific materials accepted, leave reviews on facility accessibility, and report new eco-friendly initiatives to build a resilient circular economy locally.
features: Interactive vector mapping with custom location clustering
Material-specific filter indices (plastics, batteries, compost)
Crowdsourced hub registration and moderation dashboards
Local green event calendars and workshop registrations
Eco-saving checklists and plastic foot-printing calculators
Facility photo uploads, review boards, and rating systems
Clean energy charging availability metrics in real-time
Bookmark lists for favorite hubs with offline storage

applications.title: ByteChat Developer Messenger
applications.description: An interactive real-time messaging client for developers featuring embedded code editors, live compiler sandboxes, and file snippet trees.
applications.longDescription: ByteChat redefines developer communication by embedding code sandboxes directly inside chat bubbles. Collaborate seamlessly with interactive snippet sharing, live code compiler previews for 12 languages, visual whiteboard workspaces, and developer profile cards linked with GitHub, StackOverflow, and LeetCode.
features: Interactive syntax-highlighted code sharing inside message rooms
Live executable code compile sandboxes (HTML, JS, Python, CSS)
Collaborative real-time whiteboards with vector shapes
Nested code snippet repos and history trees
GitHub repository importing and markdown doc viewers
Custom keyboard hotkeys for rapid navigations
Theme toggler matching main IDE code templates
Developer status metrics and portfolio integrations
